text: Mobile app development is an exciting field with many important decisions. One key choice is between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one system, while cross-platform apps work on both iOS and Android, saving time and money. Responsive design is also essential, so apps look good on different screen sizes. After development, apps must be published on app stores like Google Play or the App Store, where they follow strict rules. Finally, performance matters a lot. Users expect fast, smooth apps, so developers must test carefully and fix problems before release. Good planning helps create successful apps.
